independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer, session f60aa64a) authored no implementation in the DG2 scope, including none of the round-6 repairs (BE10 e057bf8, ARCH-02 a1e748b). I reviewed the frozen candidate directly: the product diff 96a3c293..51a692b1 and the full files it touches. I ran code only in disposable clones under $TMPDIR and on disposable PostgreSQL 16 clusters, which were deleted afterwards. I formed this verdict without reading any other reviewer's DG2 round-6 record.

checks_run.procedure: Rerun the round-5 repro (zz-sec-r5-probe part E) unchanged; run an exhaustive code-point sweep through the shared schemas; probe the API (Out of scope, reason, name) for placeholder-only values and for visible text with placeholders
checks_run.command: node probes/schema-sweep-r6.mts $TMPDIR/probe/packages/shared; with-pg.sh 55671|55673 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r5-probe zz-sec-r6-probe --reporter=verbose
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/probe at 51a692b1; Node 24.21.0 (sweep) and Node 22.22.2 (vitest); disposable PostgreSQL 16.13, run 1 with LANG unset and run 2 with LANG=C.UTF-8
checks_run.expected: U+16FE4 and U+1D159 alone get 400 validation.blank; no residual in the sweep; visible text keeps its marks
checks_run.actual: Part E passes in both runs (400; no charter stored; G1 still lists Out of scope as missing). Sweep over 0..10FFFF: the not-visible set equals WS, Cc, Cf, Cs, DI, U+2800, U+16FE4 and U+1D159 exactly (6341 code points); 0 extra and 0 missed. Placeholder-only and mixed values get validation.blank from freeText, name and reason. Visible text with placeholders is accepted verbatim through the schemas and the API (201, pre-check pass; reason stored verbatim). The single BAD row in the sweep log is an error in the probe's own expectation (reason ' \u0000 ' trims to 1 character, so too_small) and is annotated in the log.

checks_run.procedure: Rerun the three round-5 NUL repros unchanged. Probe NUL in nested bodies, keys, query and params; precedence (401, CSRF 403, unpermitted caller); legitimate text; real HTTP headers (llhttp); OIDC query and claims. Review the central check, db-errors and the OIDC diff.
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 55671|55673 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r5-nul zz-sec-r5-probe zz-sec-r5-oidc zz-sec-r6-probe zz-sec-r6-oidc --reporter=verbose; git diff 96a3c293..51a692b1 -- apps/api/src packages/shared/src
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/probe at 51a692b1; Node 22.22.2; disposable PostgreSQL 16.13, LANG unset and C.UTF-8
checks_run.expected: NUL anywhere gets 400 validation.invalid_character at the pointer, with no writes and no audit; authentication and rate limits are not bypassed; legitimate input is kept; OIDC behaviour is unchanged
checks_run.actual: zz-sec-r5-nul passes 4/4 in both runs (charter, name and reason get 400; counts unchanged; gap open v1). The nested NUL is reported at /stakeholders/1/name. Precedence: 401 without a session, 403 for CSRF. An unpermitted caller gets 400 whether or not the record exists (400/400), so there is no oracle. '\\0', '%00', U+0001 and U+FFFD are stored verbatim. Over real HTTP, a NUL in X-Request-Id, in User-Agent or raw in the target gets 400 from llhttp. OIDC: a NUL in state, code or error gets 302 invalid_request; a NUL sub gets token_invalid and is audited; a NUL name or email falls through; the binding, session and no roles at JIT are unchanged (r5-oidc 8/8, r6-oidc 8/8). The 22021/22P05 mapping returns a fixed message and no detail. The round-5 D1-D3 NUL-only rows now give validation.invalid_character instead of validation.blank, by design.

checks_run.procedure: Probe for other input the database refuses: lone UTF-16 surrogates in free text (text and jsonb paths) and in OIDC claims, and %ED%A0%80 in a query
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 55672 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r6-surrogate --reporter=verbose; also inside probe runs 1 and 2
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone $TMPDIR/probe at 51a692b1; Node 22.22.2; disposable PostgreSQL 16.13 with the candidate's FakeIdp; LANG unset and C.UTF-8
checks_run.actual: Main API: no 5xx. Text columns store U+FFFD (charter, gap, reason, name, PATCH); a journey step name reaching jsonb gets a declared 400 validation.format at pointer ''. A surrogate in a query gets 200. OIDC callback: a lone surrogate in sub (JIT and bind paths) gets an UNDECLARED 400 problem JSON validation.format (the contract declares 302 and 429), with no session.login_failed audit row; nothing is created. The same result in both runs. Raised as F-DG2-260 (Low, non-mandatory; the input is IdP-issued).

summary: PASS. F-DG2-230 and F-DG2-231 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. The placeholders are blank, the exhaustive sweep finds 0 residual and 0 over-blocking, and visible text keeps its marks. NUL is refused centrally with 400 validation.invalid_character at the pointer, with no writes and no audit row; authentication, CSRF and rate limits keep their precedence, OIDC identity and session behaviour is unchanged, and db-errors leaks nothing. One new Low, non-mandatory finding: F-DG2-260. A lone surrogate in an IdP-issued sub makes the OIDC callback return an undeclared 400 with no failed-login audit row. All required checks ran and passed: build, typecheck, lint, openapi:lint (161), no-cdn and format; unit tests 656/656 on Node 22, Node 24 and under load; integration 507/507 twice (LANG unset and C.UTF-8); AUD-403 146/146; historical validation of DG0 and DG1.
